Here’s a focused 2-week travel maintenance plan designed to preserve muscle and movement patterns during weeks 7–8 of her 12-week hypertrophy block. It uses only a yoga mat and a doorway pull-up bar, emphasizes full-body stimulus 4 days/week with smart progression, and includes optional “micro-loads” via tempo, pauses, and density. Volume and intensity are sufficient to maintain, not push new hypertrophy. Sessions target 35–50 minutes.

Overview
- Frequency: 4 strength sessions/week (Upper/Lower alternation), 1–2 optional mobility/zone 2 sessions.
- Intensity: RPE 7–8 on main sets; leave 1–3 reps in reserve. Avoid failure except final optional set.
- Progression week-to-week: Slight density increase (shorter rest) or an extra set on select moves; small rep progressions on pulling and single-leg patterns.
- Tempo strategies: Use slower eccentrics (3–4 sec), isometric pauses (1–2 sec), and 1.5-rep technique to preserve tension.
- Pull-up note: If unassisted bodyweight pull-ups are limited, use eccentrics, pauses at mid-range, flexed-arm hangs, or cluster sets.

Weekly Structure
- Day 1: Upper Focus A
- Day 2: Lower Focus A
- Day 3: Mobility + Zone 2 (optional)
- Day 4: Upper Focus B
- Day 5: Lower Focus B
- Day 6: Mobility/Walk (optional)
- Day 7: Rest

Warm-up (each strength day, ~6–8 minutes)
- 2 minutes brisk marching in place or step-ups on sturdy surface
- Dynamic mobility: arm circles x10/side, hip openers x10/side, inchworms x5, world’s greatest stretch x3/side
- Activation: scapular pull-ups x8–10, glute bridge x12 with 2-sec hold

Cool-down (3–5 minutes)
- Breathing: 3 sets of 5 slow breaths (4-sec inhale through nose, 6–8-sec exhale)
- Light stretches: lats, hip flexors, calves, pec doorway stretch

WEEK 1

Day 1 – Upper Focus A
1) Pull-ups or Chin-ups
- Option A: Strict reps 4–6 x 4 sets, 90–120s rest
- Option B: Eccentric clusters: 3–4 clusters of 2–3 slow negatives (5–6 sec down), 20–30s intra-cluster rest, 2 min between clusters
2) Feet-elevated Door Row (inverted row using the bar low; bend knees to scale)
- 3–4 sets x 8–12, 60–90s rest, 3-sec eccentric
3) Push-up (hands on floor; slow 3-sec down + 1-sec pause)
- 4 sets x 8–12, 60–90s rest; elevate hands on bed/desk to keep RIR 1–2
4) Pike or Decline Push-up (shoulders emphasis)
- 3 sets x 6–10, 90s rest
5) Doorframe Rear Delt Slides or T/Y/I Raises (on floor/prone)
- 3 sets x 12–15, 45–60s rest
Finisher: Flexed-arm hang (chin over bar) 2 sets x max hold; then scapular pull-ups x10

Day 2 – Lower Focus A
1) Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat (rear foot on bed/chair)
- 4 sets x 8–12/leg, 90s rest, 3-sec eccentric + 1-sec pause at bottom
2) Tempo Bodyweight Squat (1.5-rep: down–half up–down–up = 1 rep)
- 3 sets x 8–10, 60–90s rest
3) Single-Leg Hip Thrust (shoulders on bed)
- 3–4 sets x 10–14/leg, 60–90s rest, 2-sec top squeeze
4) Hamstring Slider Curls (heels on towel/pillowcase on slick floor)
- 3 sets x 8–12, 90s rest, slow 3–4 sec eccentric
5) Standing Calf Raise (single-leg)
- 4 sets x 12–20/leg, 45–60s rest, 2-sec top pause

Day 3 – Mobility + Zone 2 (optional 20–30 min)
- 15–20 min brisk walk or step-ups (RPE 4–5)
- 10 min mobility flow: cat-cow, thoracic rotations, couch stretch, pigeon, 90/90, wall slides

Day 4 – Upper Focus B
1) Neutral-Grip Pull-up or Chin-up with Mid-Range Pause
- 4 sets x 3–5 reps, 2-sec pause at halfway up, 120s rest; or 4 x 15–25s eccentric-only reps
2) Inverted Row (supinated or neutral grip)
- 4 sets x 8–12, 60–90s rest, feet elevated if strong
3) Close-Grip Push-up (triceps bias)
- 3–4 sets x 8–12, 60–90s, 2-sec pause just off floor
4) Pseudo Planche Push-up (hands turned out, shoulders over wrists)
- 3 sets x 6–10, 90s rest
5) Doorway Lateral Raise Iso-Holds (press forearm into jamb at ~30–60° abduction)
- 3 sets x 20–30s/side + 10–12 slow reps of wall angels

Day 5 – Lower Focus B
1) Skater Squat or Assisted Pistol to Box
- 4 sets x 5–8/leg, 90s rest, control tempo
2) Reverse Lunge (long stride, hinge bias)

Day 6 – Optional Low-Intensity

Day 7 – Rest

- Door pull-up bar: Ensure hinge side of door is used; test stability. For inverted rows, set bar at hip height in doorway if your model allows; otherwise substitute doorframe towel rows: loop towel over bar, lean back, row.

Here’s a concise, side-by-side summary of the 2-week, bodyweight-only travel maintenance plan (with 15-minute finishers). Equipment: yoga mat + doorway pull-up bar. Goal: maintain muscle and patterns; Week 2 adds modest overload for a “progress” feel.

Weekly structure (both weeks)
- 4 strength days: Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B
- 1–2 optional mobility/zone 2 days; 1 full rest day
- Main set intensity: RPE 7–8, leave 1–2 reps in reserve
- Session length: ~40–55 minutes including finisher

WEEK 1 (hold) vs WEEK 2 (progressed)

Day 1 – Upper A
- Pull-ups/Chins: W1 4 x 4–6 (or 4 eccentric clusters). W2 5 x 4–6 (or 5 clusters); last set optional AMRAP to 1 RIR.
- Inverted Row: W1 3–4 x 8–12 (3s eccentric). W2 4 x 10–13.
- Push-up (tempo): W1 4 x 8–12 (3s down + 1s pause). W2 4 x 10–14 with 2s pause just off floor.
- Pike/Decline Push-up: W1 3 x 6–10. W2 3–4 x 8–11.
- Rear Delt T/Y/I or Door Slides: W1 3 x 12–15. W2 3–4 x 12–15 + 10–15s iso at end.
- Finisher (15 min):
  - W1 EMOM alt: burpees + push-ups/hangs. 
  - W2 AMRAP chipper: 12 burpees • 16 push-ups • 24 air squats • 30 mtn climbers/side; aim to beat W1 density.

Day 2 – Lower A
- RFESS: W1 4 x 8–12/leg (3s down + 1s pause). W2 5 x 8–12/leg with 2–3s bottom pause.
- 1.5-Rep Squat: W1 3 x 8–10. W2 3–4 x 9–10.
- Single-Leg Hip Thrust: W1 3–4 x 10–14/leg. W2 4 x 12–15/leg (2–3s squeeze on last reps).
- Hamstring Slider Curls: W1 3 x 8–12 (3–4s down). W2 4 x 9–12; last 3 reps 4s down.
- Single-Leg Calf Raise: W1 4 x 12–20/leg (2s top). W2 4–5 x 16–22/leg (2s top + 1s bottom).
- Finisher (15 min):
  - W1 30s on/15s move through 5 leg/cardio drills x 3 cycles.
  - W2 EMOM 15: 20–26 lunges; 22–28 squats (2s down); 35–45s fast step-ups/march.

Day 3 – Optional easy day (both weeks)
- 15–25 min brisk walk (RPE 4–5) + 10 min mobility flow.
- Note: If fatigued in W1, substitute the provided 25–35 min active rest session for Day 4 and resume schedule.

Day 4 – Upper B
- Pull-up/Chin (mid-range pause): W1 4 x 3–5 with 2s pause (or 4 x 15–25s negatives). W2 5 x 3–5 with pause (or 5 slow negatives).
- Inverted Row: W1 4 x 8–12. W2 4 x 10–13 (feet elevated if strong).
- Close-Grip Push-up: W1 3–4 x 8–12 (2s pause just off floor). W2 4 x 9–13 with pause.
- Pseudo-Planche Push-up: W1 3 x 6–10. W2 3–4 x 8–11 (slightly more lean).
- Lateral Raise Isos + Wall Angels: W1 3 x 20–30s/side + 10–12. W2 3 x 25–35s/side + 12–15.
- Finisher (15 min):
  - W1 Ladder 1–5–1 tri-set: pull-up cluster • push-ups • air squats.
  - W2 30s on/30s off x10 alternating pull-up density and fast push drill; aim +1 total strict rep or +10–15s total hang time.

Day 5 – Lower B
- Skater Squat or Assisted Pistol: W1 4 x 5–8/leg (3s down). W2 5 x 6–9/leg.
- Reverse Lunge (hinge bias): W1 3–4 x 8–12/leg. W2 4 x 10–13/leg.
- Nordic Hip Hinge on Knees: W1 3 x 10–14. W2 3–4 x 12–16.
- Sliding Eccentrics + Hip Bridge: W1 3 sets: 6–8 eccentrics + 10 bridges. W2 3 sets: 8–10 eccentrics + 12 bridges.
- Tibialis Raises: W1 3 x 15–20. W2 3–4 x 18–25.
- Finisher (15 min):
  - W1 40s on/20s off x10 alternating fast hip-hinge or glute bridges with skater hops + calf pumps.
  - W2 45s on/15s off x10 rotating 5 athletic drills twice; aim 5–10% more total reps on 2 stations.

Day 6 – Optional low-intensity (both weeks)
- 20–30 min easy walk + 10 min gentle yoga or breath work.

Day 7 – Rest (both weeks)

Key cues (both weeks)
- Tempo and pauses: Use 3–4s eccentrics and 1–3s pauses to drive tension.
- Scaling: Elevate push-up hands, bend knees for rows, adjust depth/assist on skater squats.
- Autoregulate: Keep 1–2 RIR on main lifts; if fatigue spikes, trim accessory sets or cap finisher at 12–13 minutes.

Nutrition and recovery highlights
- Maintenance calories; protein 0.7–1.0 g/lb/day across 3–4 meals.
- Hydration 2–3 L/day; extra sodium if hot/flying.
- Sleep target 7–9 hours; consistent wake time.

Success markers across the two weeks
- Match or beat Week 1 best sets on pull-ups, push-ups, and RFESS by Week 2 (within 1 rep counts).
- Complete 4/4 sessions and 4/4 finishers weekly at RPE 7–8.
- Optional: Average bodyweight within ±1 lb week to week.

This side-by-side keeps the plan clear, reinforces the Week 2 progression, and fits the travel constraints.
